{{Top|leg}}
A '''restraint capsule''' was an upgraded version of a [[force cage]] that could be installed aboard [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. [[Damorind Securities]] manufactured the [[RPC-12]] restraint capsule during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
